storyboard.part: A: Super Admin Security Controls & Infrastructure

scenes.title: Super Admin Security Gateway & 1-Click Login
scenes.details: Emergency maintenance gateway, 1-click admin demo login (admin@flarebase.dev), and RS256 token validation.

scenes.title: Telemetry & Rate Limits Governance
scenes.details: Real-time CPU/RAM telemetry, active query latency charts, dynamic token bucket rate limits, and DDoS defense.

scenes.title: Network Access Center & CIDR Rules
scenes.details: Subnet access control, real-time client device roster, bandwidth metering, and 1-click IP toggle blocking.

scenes.title: Auto Threat Detection & User Security Radar
scenes.details: 5 KPI summary cards, composite risk scores (0-100), D_hash hardware device fingerprints, and live security audit scans.

scenes.title: Universal Server Hosting & Bare-Metal Recovery
scenes.details: Dual Local/LAN IP discovery, Cloudflare edge tunnel integration, and 6-digit RECOVERY_PIN emergency console.

scenes.title: Developer Metrics & Project Management
scenes.details: Developer metrics dashboard, scoped API keys, workspace isolation, and repository synchronization.

scenes.title: GitHub-Grade Organizations & Functional Teams
scenes.details: Multi-tenant workspace switcher, member rosters, functional groups (@org/team), and granular project access grants.

scenes.title: NoSQL Document Database & Row-Level Security
scenes.details: Schemaless JSON collections, document editor with _rules evaluation, and reactive search filtering.

scenes.title: Storage Vault & Visual 500MB Quotas
scenes.details: Binary magic byte header inspection, real-time visual byte quota metering bar, and temporary signed URLs.

scenes.title: User Security Console: Passkeys, Sessions & PATs
scenes.details: FIDO2 WebAuthn Passkeys, active sessions with remote device killswitch, scoped PATs, and GDPR Art. 20 export.

scenes.title: Unified Platform Architecture Showcase
scenes.details: Outro summary card showcasing both Super Admin Security Controls and Developer BaaS Primitives.
